g.title: NavigationBrain
g.text: Navigation brain — every region & pathway, as implemented
the action-selection brain (one half of the shared "one brain") · per-direction pools collapsed ×4 (N/E/S/W)
the move now EMERGES from a spiking race (accumulate → commit) by DEFAULT — the hand-coded shortcut is retired
signal nature + direction + learning + gating shown · faithful-vs-shortcut flagged (see legend)

g.title: cluster_sc
g.text: : the move emerges from the spiking race)

g.title: cluster_motor
g.text: (C10 · the body acts on which pool fires)

g.title: scros
g.text: pools bump CENTRE → proximity (the reward r)

g.title: rus
g.text: FIRES the reward r (drops the host write)

g.title: sel
g.text: builds up support for each direction (slow NMDA)

g.title: commit
g.text: an all-or-none burst PICKS the move

g.title: opn
g.text: keeps all bursts silent until one direction wins (omnipause)

g.title: purk
g.text: ⚠ FS preset stands in for PC

g.title: body
g.text: agent moves on grid · world renders next image

g.title: leg
g.text: slow inhibition — GABA_B / GIRK K⁺ (E=−90) · the value subtraction
dopamine broadcast — neuromodulator scalar (not a synapse)
dashed border / edge = opt-in (flag-gated) or weaker/feedback
runtime gate (transmission / plasticity) · gate name in label
per-action template (N/E/S/W); cross-action arcs shown once, labelled
host-rendered input / decoded output = environment/body boundary (LEGITIMATE)
documented SHORTCUT: collapsed/phenomenological stand-in OR host-computed code
(e.g. place/goal coords). Substrate-wide: point neurons · 1-step delay ·
